_doc: Canonical publication grid shared by all three machines. Each machine runs only its --models slice; never change this roster while merging into the same output root.
_headline: Synthetic · Reason off · feat full · opaque labels · n=100 · macro-F1
_label_note: scripts/grid.py schedules visible labels only for real datasets. Synthetic datasets run only the opaque/hidden arm.
_real_grid_note: The secondary real-data suite is deliberately limited to reason=off/on x visible/opaque labels x full features x n=50. scripts/grid.py keeps historic per-cell config.json files unchanged and filters execution/aggregation to this schedule, so existing partial Ollama results remain merge-compatible.
_llm_settings_note: Inductive one-row requests, label metrics only, and zero tolerance for parser fallbacks.
